column1: # Scenario catalog (TAB-separated) for the REMOTE-TARGET example. Parsed by
# 'body' is empty for GET rows (two adjacent tabs). Fields never contain a tab.
# 'target'/'diagnostic' are unused for a plain black-box or remote-observed run, but
# STANDALONE remote diagnostics (PERFLAB_REMOTE_DIAGNOSTICS=1) do read them: 'target'
# maps to a PERFLAB_DIAG_TARGETS entry (service -> assembly) and 'diagnostic' is the
# default kind. For those, set 'target' to a real mapping key and 'diagnostic' to
# trace/gcdump (not 'none'). Repoint 'path' at your deployment's real routes.
# (The sample paths below match the scenariolab app, so pointing this lab at a
# locally brought-up scenariolab stack on 127.0.0.1:8080 returns 200s -- the
# simplest way to exercise remote mode without a separate deployment.)
